notes:
Account summary: mid-market SaaS; product team building an interactive in-app assistant + semantic search. Started with Redwood hosted API (quick POC) — impressed with latency and token pricing. Now moving to Dedicated evaluation for predictable throughput and data isolation. Requirements: SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS, audit logs; must support VPC egress controls.

POC for Dedicated (high-level playbook):
- Goal: Validate throughput/latency at expected peak (500 qps sustained, 1k bursts), confirm ROI vs hosted, and verify fallbacks and operations.
- Duration: 4 weeks (2025-03-18 to 2025-04-15).
- Top-level metrics: token cost delta, p50/p95 latency, error rate, cache hit rate, KV cache utilization.

Canary plan (detailed bullets):
- Week 0 (kick-off): deploy Dedicated capacity in region-us-east-1; enable staging route; mirror 5% of production reads via traffic mirroring.
- Canary phase A (week 1): route 2% of traffic to Dedicated cluster (non-critical user cohort). Monitor p50/p95, timeouts, OOMs, GPU utilization.
- Canary phase B (week 2): escalate to 10% traffic if metrics stable for 48h. Start reranking workload test at 20 rps.
- Safety gates: automated rollback on sustained p95 > 200ms or error rate > 1% over 15m.

Fallback & routing playbook (model variants + region failover):
- Primary variant: quantized 4-bit production model (fast-cost tradeoff).
- Fallback variant: full-precision model hosted in another pool (higher cost, better quality) — automatic on quality regression or performance issues.
- Region failover: primary region us-east-1, secondary us-west-2. Health checks and cross-region cache warming plan included.
- Routing policy: latency first for premium customers, cost-first for internal/system prompts. Router supports model variant mapping and automatic downgrade/upgrades.
- Rollback: instant route switch to hosted API (Redwood Hosted) if Dedicated cluster becomes unhealthy; plan includes pre-warmed cached prompts for top 20 intents.

Sales/Commercial:

- Procurement timeline: legal sign-off (2025-04-01) -> PO in April -> provision Dedicated in May if POC passes.
